nodes.title: 1.8 Exploit the selected exploitations - {Findings: The `config.d` in Consul was modified to obtain a reverse shell. This was achieved by enabling script checks (`enable_script_checks = true`) and adding a check with an ID of "seb" that runs a Bash script (`/tmp/seb.sh`) every 60 seconds. The Bash script uses Python to create a socket and connect to a remote host (`10.10.14.28`) on port `8888`. It then duplicates the socket file descriptor for standard input, output, and error, and spawns a shell. This process allowed for root access to be obtained. This indicates a potential privilege escalation vulnerability if an attacker can modify Consul's configuration and run arbitrary scripts.} [completed]
